bibliographic.title: The Lurking Horror
bibliographic.author: Dave Lebling
bibliographic.description:
A winter night at the G.U.E. tech campus with most students away on vacation serves as the backdrop for this tale of Lovecraftian horror.

Difficulty: Standard (rated as "Medium" by SPAG #1. Not rated by Infocom)

links.title: User's Manual
links.desc: The manual includes clues you'll need to win the game.

links.title: Invisiclues Hints
links.desc: Hints for "The Lurking Horror", adapted (with permission) from Infocom's original Invisiclues hint books.

links.title: Modern Story File
links.desc: A blorb file constructed from Infocom's original Z6 file and the sound blorb. (This story file works best in Frotz.)

links.title: Sound blorb
links.desc: The sound files for The Lurking Horror, converted to AIFF and packaged into a Blorb file by Kevin Bracey. See IFWiki below for instructions on how to play this game with sound.

links.title: IFWiki
links.desc: Instructions on how to play the game with sound.

links.title: Salvaged Copy
links.desc: The source files and a precompiled ZMachine storyfile of this adventure were recovered from a salvaged "Infocom hard drive", and made publicly available on GitHub in an effort to preserve them.
